definitions.explanation: Indicates that a machine, system, factory, or piece of equipment is currently functioning and in use. Commonly seen on status displays and signs.

examples.japanese: ⟦エレベーター→エレベーター：01340_erebeetaa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{稼働中|かどうちゅう}です。
⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二十四|にじゅうよ}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧{稼働中|かどうちゅう}だ。
⟦サーバー→サーバー：04755_saabaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{稼働中|かどうちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、メンテナンス⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{延期|えんき}する→延期する：02517_enkisuru⟧。
examples.english: Since the server is currently running, maintenance will be postponed to next week.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{稼働|かどう}→稼働：16938_kadou⟧ (operation, running) and ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (during, in the middle of). Used as a status indicator for machines, systems, factories, and other operational things. Commonly seen on signs, dashboards, and status displays.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦サーバー→サーバー：04755_saabaa⟧{稼働中|かどうちゅう}: server running
- ⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧{稼働中|かどうちゅう}: factory in operation
- {稼働中|かどうちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧: a system in operation
- {二十四|にじゅうよ}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧{稼働中|かどうちゅう}: running 24 hours

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{運転中|うんてんちゅう}→運転中：09659_untenchuu⟧: in operation — used for vehicles and machines that "drive" or "run"
- ⟦{営業中|えいぎょうちゅう}→営業中：09539_eigyouchuu⟧: open for business — used for shops and restaurants
- ⟦{使用中|しようちゅう}→使用中：09554_shiyouchuu⟧: in use — used for restrooms, meeting rooms, etc.
